CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN.description: Cloudflare API token with Workers Scripts, D1 and account settings permissions.

FEISHU_APP_ID.description: Feishu bot App ID selected during the SDK device-authorization flow.

FEISHU_APP_SECRET.description: Feishu bot App Secret returned by the SDK device-authorization flow.

FEISHU_RECEIVE_ID.description: Receiver Feishu open_id returned by the SDK device-authorization flow.

ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Random bearer token used by creator management and manual-run APIs.
